description:
Use this when you need a state/territory-wide Australian public-holiday result. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when you do not know the state/territory, or you need a local council, regional, employer, exchange or industry calendar.
What it computes: Checks an Australian date for a required state or territory using the Fair Work Ombudsman 2026-2027 public-holiday tables and explicit scope limitations.
Example user requests: Is 2026-04-27 a working day in NSW? | Check 2027-12-27 in Victoria.
Inputs: date (date); division (enum).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2026-04-27","division":"nsw"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, division, division_name, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, weekend_days, holiday_names, holiday_observed, limited_or_part_day_events, calendar_scope, calendar_profile, source_quality, regional_policy, dataset_version.
Formula: is_working_day = CLDR AU weekend baseline and no state/territory-wide full-day public holiday
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/australia-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/australia-working-day.md

division.description: Required Australian state/territory code: act, nsw, nt, qld, sa, tas, vic or wa.

name: check_australia_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: State/territory-wide full-day public holidays plus weekly baseline.

day_type.description: Regular weekday, regular weekend or public holiday.

holiday_names.description: Full-day public holidays applying on the date.

holiday_observed.description: True when an additional/substitute date is explicitly listed.

is_working_day.description: True when the date is not a weekend or included full-day state/territory public holiday.

limited_or_part_day_events.description: Regional, partial-day, public-service-only or otherwise limited events that do not close the full division by default.

source_quality.description: Official government sources with state/territory scope.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: Australia State/Territory Public-Holiday Working Day
